Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. MEDIUM Tiny litre amounts are accepted and then shown as "0 L"
   where: /beds Record past watering form (POST /api/waterings)
   expected: An amount below the field's 0.1 L minimum is refused, or it is shown as a non-zero amount
   saw: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 11 Nov 2026."]}

2. MEDIUM Waterings page crashes on a malformed list response and stays on "Loading waterings…"
   where: /waterings bed filter (GET /api/waterings?bed_id=)
   expected: A visible error, no uncaught exception, and the loading text cleared
   saw: {"pe":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"],"alerts":["Loading waterings…"],"text":["Waterings","Every time a bed was watered.","Water a bed","Bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner","Clear filter","Loading waterings…","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","ACTIONS","12 Nov 2026, 19:05\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","watering of North bed","11 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t0 L\tDelete","watering of Shade corner","11 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t0 L\tDelete","watering of Shade corner","11 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t0 L\tDelete"]}

3. MEDIUM Hung filter request leaves other beds' waterings under the chosen bed filter, loading forever
   where: /waterings bed filter
   expected: After choosing Shade corner, only its waterings show, or a loading or timeout state replaces the old list
   saw: {"alerts":["Loading waterings…"],"north":["12 Nov 2026, 19:05\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","10 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"fields":[{"label":"Bed","value":"2"}]}

   expected: A date such as 0001-01-01 is refused as implausible
   saw: {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-190413-hunt-10ac/probes/misc.mjs (expectation "ancient-date-refused")
